items.title: Rainbow Warriors Drop Road Finale At Nevada
items.summary: RENO, Nev. — In its final road contest and Mountain West matchup of the season, the University of Hawai'i Rainbow Warrior football fell to the Nevada Wolf Pack, 16-8, on a chilly  Saturday night at Mackay Stadium.

items.title: Warriors Fall Short Against North Dakota State
items.summary: HONOLULU — On a rainy night in Manoa, the University of Hawai'i football team's postseason hopes were doused by a 21-13 loss to North Dakota State on Saturday at the Clarence T.C. Complex.

items.title: Warriors Host North Dakota State Looking For Third Straight Win
items.summary: HONOLULU – The University of Hawai'i football team returns to Ching Complex for its first home game in nearly a month when it hosts North Dakota State on Saturday at 6 p.m. The Rainbow Warriors will look to extend their winning streak to three games and keep their hopes of bowl eligibility alive when they take on the Bison for the first time ever. items.title: Lacaden Named Mountain West Freshman of the Week
items.summary: LAS VEGAS  – University of Hawai'i wide receiver Titan Lacaden was selected as the Mountain West Freshman of the Week after leading the Rainbow Warriors to a 17-14 road victory over UTEP on Saturday. The victory marked Hawai'i's second consecutive road win of the season.

items.title: Warriors Get Past UTEP To Pick Up Second Straight Road Win
items.summary: EL PASO, Texas – The University of Hawai'i football team continued its winning momentum with a hard-fought 17-14 victory over UTEP Saturday night at the Sun Bowl. With their second straight road win, the Rainbow Warriors improved to 3-6 overall and 2-4 in the Mountain West.

items.title: Heil Named to Midseason Watch List For Ray Guy Award
items.summary: AUGUSTA, Ga. – The Augusta Sports Council announced the Midseason Watch List for the 2026 Ray Guy Award with University of Hawai'i freshman Gehrig Heil making the list. Named for football's premier punter, the Ray Guy Award honors the nation's top collegiate punter in the Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS).

items.title: Legendary Football Coach June Jones Passes Away
items.summary: HONOLULU — The University of Hawai?i Athletics Department and the entire Rainbow Warrior family mourn the passing of legendary former head football coach June Jones. Jones passed away Thursday morning in Oregon at the age of 73.
